processing: Auditioned PCM converted to mono 32k PCM16. Emily retains two independent takes, medium/firm layers and natural decays up to 4 seconds; bass up to 3.5 seconds. Short end fades. Other source dynamics survive through note velocity. Cabinet processing is native Web Audio, not baked into notes.

cabinet.description: Fender Deluxe Reverb speaker response originally from Soundwoofer; a linear cabinet response, not an amplifier model.

uprightProcessing: Mono 32 kHz float PCM, DC/onset trim, per-note peak .85 as in the existing source audition, natural tails up to 4s, short edge fades. Pitch centres measured from three autocorrelation windows; correction applied by sampler. Original SFZ velocity regions retained; two takes. No extra EQ, compressor or noise layer. Bundled as PCM16. Runtime source calibration -3 dB follows the matched audition.
